stops.note: a figure of superhuman strength or courage, often semi-divine
in Greek, a demigod or warrior honoured after death with cult worship
stops.meaning: a legendary figure of great deeds

stops.note: carried the legendary figure into French
settled as the English word for a figure of great courage
stops.meaning: a person admired for courage or noble deeds

current_meaning: a person admired for courage, achievements, or noble qualities
